patch_description:
Redesigned the EVOLVE-BLOCK to a compact 16-parameter ansatz per block: apply trainable RY on all 8 qubits, two-layer CZ “ring” entanglement (no parameters), then trainable RX on all 8 qubits.  
This drastically reduces the number of circuit parameters (back to 98 total, matching the best-performing family), improving parameter efficiency while keeping the same connectivity flexibility and re-uploading/measurement pipeline unchanged.
